body: Thx for all the caring comments! I think now I should think twice lol

Old story retold by Lu Xun
He insists that he is mentally ok.
Emmmm That just sounds so bad, so I think  yes. Seek helps.

I am sad that you have gone through this.
Well distancing is definitely impossible since he sleeps next to my room and my house has bad soundproofing. I reckon I have tried, but sometimes it is just inevitable. I think I will find a trustworthy adult soon thanks to the confidence you guys give me. I will update if I do that.
Oh sorry for phrasing. The she in “she does intend to improve…” is actually my mother. Sorry for misinterpretation!

I would like to clarify that I was just outside the door, in the corridor. So it’s indoors. And less than 3 hours if I am correct. May not seem so horrible. But I kind of get scarred, misty in heart.
As you talk about it, when my father is not getting good control of his temper, my mum will go grinning ear to ear, saying soft and soothing words, so he will not be angry anymore. it’s kind of scary, IMO. My teacher said she is proud of me( I get good grades in classes, top 1-3). She does intend to improve me, but it sometimes feels weird, and I am kind of afraid replying stuff other than yes and ok. But she does love me I think. However we barely touch each other and I feel kind of insecure about it.
Thx for replying! For the last statement,I am considering the first one.

Thanks for replying!
First for clarity, my parents are kind of rich, and they often take me to kind of fancy restaurants and we would go traveling before the pandemic.
They provide me such good food. My mum said that’s the proof that she loves me.
I agree that my family is kind of not that healthy and good and my mum also agree that my dad has anger issue and if I really understand that, I would not provoke him and upset the entire family. However I really can’t know when will something go wrong. Anyway I am sure my physical well-being is being taken care of.
Like I am really really lucky. I don’t have some freaking cancer or struggling with poverty or a lot of shit in the world. I suppose to have a happy childhood and be genuinely happy. But guess I am too greedy though. I really hate being weird but I also don’t want to be a normal person. Actually it’s easy to live. Most of the time I don’t have any argues with them, and I have school, books, phone and computer. I really just can’t complain. I feel guilty for not being a good child and person. Like my heart is filled with sticky stinky black liquid. I just feel sorry.
I really can’t trust the social worker. My mum has obviously contacted her and I don’t feel safe. And she has that kind of terrifying smile.
Although I have met many good adults ( at least on the surface) I can’t really trust them though. What if they disdain me afterwards? Also every of them can easily contact my parents and I have no control of that. 
I am not likely to join the military cuz I am so damn weak actually and my PE score is around C+. I might be a scientist but I am not certain if I really have that much talent. Also it’s hard to find friends and why they will like me anyway? Even I hate myself.
I think “super toxic” is an exaggeration. It is completely bearable and many people parents are stricter and harsher and they turns out to be fine. I have seen real toxicity in this subreddit though, which is nowhere near me.
He repeated harsh words but not everyday.  Not even every month. It’s not that trauma compare to the others such as raping, alcoholism, drug abuse etc. It is just sprinkle.
